definition-changed.answer: RV1 governs an argument of class alphabetic or alphanumeric; those are the same Table 3 rows in both. The open 2002 reading of a numeric/boolean USAGE NATIONAL item (§2002:8.5.2.7 item 3 vs §2002:8.5.2.9; PB5625 Reading 2) places such an item in class numeric/boolean or national, never alphabetic/alphanumeric, so it never reaches RV1. Scope unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: ORD is an integer function; under standard arithmetic its value is held in a standard intermediate data item (§2002:15.3.1), and an ordinal position (at most the size of the character set) is exact in 31 or 34 digits, so §2002:8.8.1.x and PB5575 cannot change it. §2002:15/15.1 differ only in function-type text about returned lengths, which an integer function does not have. No dependence.
